mapper.update: update llm_skill_file set delete_flag = -1 , updated_by = #{updatedBy} , updated_dt = #{updatedDt} where id = #{id}
update llm_skill_file set delete_flag = -1 , updated_by = #{updatedBy} , updated_dt = now() where skill_id = #{skillId} and delete_flag = 1
mapper.select: select id , skill_id , file_path , description , sort from llm_skill_file where delete_flag = 1 and skill_id = #{skillId} order by sort asc , id asc
